task.question: What sentence did John McDonald receive on 3 January, 2026 for the fatal incident at Aston Wood Golf Course?
task.answer: 13 years and six months in prison.
task.evidence: 3 January – John McDonald, who knocked down and fatally injured Suzanne Cherry at Aston Wood Golf Course in Staffordshire while being pursued by police, is sentenced to 13 years and six months in prison

John McDonald jailed for Aston Wood Golf Club death

A man has been jailed for eight years after causing the death of a fellow golfer at a Sutton Coldfield golf club.

John McDonald, 52, of Tamworth, was sentenced at Birmingham Crown Court on 3 January 2026 after being convicted of manslaughter.

The court heard McDonald got into an altercation with the victim at Aston Wood Golf Club in July 2024, during which he struck the man, who later died from his injuries.

McDonald showed no remorse during the trial, the court was told.

Judge [name] sentenced McDonald to eight years in prison, saying the attack was "unprovoked and cowardly."

West Midlands Police said they welcomed the sentence.

FINAL: John McDonald received an 8-year prison sentence for manslaughter on 3 January 2026.
